display.summary: OCR for registered document files, with project-image service controls and bounded extraction.
highlights: Registered document files gain optional OCR, extracted-text viewing, search, backfill and legacy-text adoption.
System Settings controls OCR and starts/stops its internal service through Composer after current-password confirmation.
The OCR service runs from the project image with optional engine dependencies and offline model files; this first OCR release requires an image rebuild.
Bounded upload and extraction queues retry overload; results from replaced files remain historical.
Includes verified DjangoLux 1.14 stable behavior and Composer wrapper 4 compatibility.
